host_observations.note: The 45 P03 tests are included in the 1669 total; they are not an additional set of 45 unique tests beyond that total.

independence: This reviewer authored no implementation, test harness, qualification runner or enforcement code. It authored only the separate read-only audit. Its delegated lifecycle reviewer independently checked that scope without edits, builds or test reruns.

lifecycle_observations.details: See independent lifecycle-review.json for exact refs, device-memory accounting, skipped commands, timeout ownership, module setup failures and the three DMA allocation stages including after descriptor publication.

limitations: Only six ordinary FP16/BF16-to-FP32 matmul signatures, declared compact layouts, C=+0 and the frozen profile are qualified. Other operator families remain unavailable.
Native processor RTL bypasses the AFU; integer DPI helpers remain. No vendor hw_emu, FPGA, physical bandwidth/latency/power, synthesis/PPA or silicon evidence is established.
Actual SimX lifecycle tests and host mock tests are distinct. Mocked device-loss, cleanup errors and sentinel arithmetic do not constitute actual GPU error injection or numerical proof.

SimX DMA allocation failures cover backend/common staging registration and software-CP scratch creation. They do not establish arbitrary simulator exceptions, physical bus/device-loss recovery, transactional rollback of partial DMA, or exhaustive backend-construction failure safety.
Device allocator bytes and intrusive reference counts are checked; these are not whole-process host-heap leak measurements.
The trusted compiler/module/backend binding is source-bound qualification evidence, not authentication against malicious concurrent filesystem writers or arbitrary hardware.
The local hashed binaries/tools were independently verified while available. Portable publication retains source/configuration/raw results and hashes, not a binary-replay archive.
Earlier preflight-blocked and controlled-interruption packets are historical failures/partial work, never accepted evidence.

No new performance/model_parity execution is claimed. Phase closure still requires retention of existing A01/P02 prerequisites and accurate published acceptance/documents; this receipt does not fabricate human approval or self-issue a waiver.

nonblocking_clarifications.detail: RV32 raw configuration.cache_enabled=false denotes disabled compiler caching (CCACHE_DISABLE=1); exact compiler flags have hardware instruction/data caches enabled. Preserve raw receipt and clarify this meaning in publication.

recommendations.P03-A02: accept at rtl_verified scope for the six declared signatures on SimX and native processor RTL
recommendations.P03-A03: accept at simulated scope for actual RV32 and RV64 SimX lifecycle integration with separately identified host mocks
